reviews.boundary_analysis: Inward dependency direction, forbidden Application transport/persistence dependencies and endpoint composition boundaries are explicit. The enforced Api-to-Domain allowance and production-to-test ban are separately registered, so prose versus checker graph differences are not new.

Four-layer project graph and reference confirmation/checker obligations are registered, including the broader Api allowlist. Filename classification is already independent BF0032. Prior hook feedback and snapshot discoveries remain distinct and preserved.

Domain simplicity, independence from a particular use case as the rich-behavior criterion, approval exception and no appearance-driven DDD are all explicit in the union. No extra obligation inferred from examples.
Application service orchestration, size as a responsibility signal, abstraction placement, scoped operation orchestration and no Infrastructure-facing registration dependency are already extracted.

Application owns used abstractions, Infrastructure implements repositories; caching abstraction is conditional on the use case. Interface/concrete-helper guidance is also primary EXTRA0102, not a new blanket interface requirement.

Application excludes EF and transport types; use one context as unit of work and keep persistence configuration outside Domain where practical. Remote contracts must not reuse Domain entities. Specific middleware/interceptor boundaries remain for their policy reviews.

Program is the composition root; controllers avoid implementation types and repeated caller identity is mediated by an Application abstraction. ClaimsPrincipal exclusion is independently BF0053 as well.

Repository abstraction/implementation placement and scaffold layer/reference limits are represented. Approved DDD folders and root execution of reference checks retain their qualifications; no new claim from folder illustrations.
